# `⍀` — Scan first

Keys: `Alt-Minus Backslash`

`f⍀Y` scans down the first axis.

```bpl
+⍀[1 2 3 ⋄ 4 5 6]  ⍝ [1 2 3 ⋄ 5 7 9]
```

`S f⍀ Y` supplies a seed.

```bpl
10+⍀[1 2 ⋄ 3 4]    ⍝ [11 12 ⋄ 14 16]
```

Seeds, `⍠K` and errors follow [`\`](backslash.qmd).

## Inverse

`f⍀⁻¹` undoes `f⍀` when `f` has an inverse.

```bpl
×⍀⁻¹[1 2 ⋄ 3 8]   ⍝ [1 2 ⋄ 3 4]
```
